title: Minecraft Skeleton
blurb: Dry bone-clatter, somewhere close, which means arrows are already in the air and your dirt hut is one wall short. Skeletons are the reason Minecraft nights feel tense rather than merely dark — they shoot from range, they refuse to burn quickly enough, and that rattle offers about as much warning as a creeper does. For a whole generation of players the sound triggers combat instincts calibrated in primary school. Good for spooky-but-not-frightening moments, skeleton war content, or ambushing a friend who genuinely believed they had sealed the entrance behind them.
origin: The skeleton mob sound from Minecraft (Mojang).
